event_name: Time 16:38 2019 BELGIAN GRAND PRIX 29 August - 1 September 2019 The Stewards have received a request from ROKit Williams Racing to allow car 88 to start the race despite failing to set a qualifying time in Q1. In accordance with Article 35.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations, the Stewards grant permission for car 88, Robert Kubica, to start the race, as the driver has set satisfactory times in practice at this Event. The car will be placed on the grid in accordance with Article 35.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
